title: Earthy Spanish Quiche
description: A savory quiche filled with the flavors of Spain, featuring earthy mushrooms and a crumbly crust.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place in a tart pan.
In a skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the onion, tomato, chorizo, and garlic. Cook until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Pour the vegetable mixture into the pie crust.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
